summary: Faz 8 CP2 Frontend RBAC UI smoke test. Verified admin-only Şirketler + Yetkiler tabs, CompaniesManagement CRUD + cross-company permission toggles, ManagerVisibilityManagement checkbox matrix, UserManagement 3-role picker + company dropdown + role badges + regression testids. Executed full RBAC E2E across serkan/mgr_test/emp1_test with sequential logins (single-session compliant). Found & fixed one critical regression (isTeamView undefined in TaskCard) that crashed Tasks panel for non-admin users; after fix, RBAC visibility grant works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — TaskCard referenced isTeamView from useAuth destructured only in the parent TasksPanel; when a task had assignee_name/company_name a ReferenceError ('isTeamView is not defined') was thrown → 'SERTEX · SİSTEM HATASI' error screen for mgr_test/emp1_test on Tasks tab. Fix: added isTeamView to TaskCard props and pass-through in both TaskCard + ReorderableTaskCard call-sites.

action_items: Review the TasksPanel.jsx fix (isTeamView prop drilling) applied by testing agent for correctness — no business logic changed, just prop passing.

Regression testid `storage-progress-bar` mentioned in review request does not exist anywhere in /app/frontend/src — either remove from acceptance criteria or add the missing testid to the storage progress bar element in UserManagement.jsx / storage summary component.
`sertex_tab_order_v1` localStorage key is not written until user manually reorders tabs; regression check passed via inspection only (feature still works — user drags tab).
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is 1790 lines and mixes many concerns (TaskCard, SubtaskRow, EditTaskModal, TasksPanel, ContextMenu, Reorder scheduler). Recommend splitting into TaskCard.jsx / SubtaskRow.jsx / EditTaskModal.jsx to prevent regressions like the isTeamView bug (which was caused by only the parent destructuring the hook value while child JSX referenced the identifier).
CompaniesManagement uses window.confirm() for delete — replace with in-app dialog for a11y + consistency with rest of Sertex UI.

In CompaniesManagement.jsx setEditing state is keyed by company.name in some testids (`company-edit-input-${c.name}`, `company-save-${c.name}`) but by id in state — when a name is being edited, the testid captures the ORIGINAL name (works for tests, but brittle if names contain special chars).

rca of the issue: TaskCard component (line 707 in TasksPanel.jsx) referenced identifier `isTeamView` at line 977 but did not destructure it from its props. Only the outer TasksPanel used `const { isTeamView } = useAuth();`. When mgr_test/emp1_test logged in and Tasks panel rendered any task with assignee_name or company_name populated, React threw ReferenceError and ErrorBoundary rendered 'SERTEX · SİSTEM HATASI' screen. Admin did not hit this because our admin flow did not open Tasks tab, and admin's isTeamView was truthy anyway. Fix: destructure isTeamView on TaskCard props and forward from both TasksPanel → TaskCard and TasksPanel → ReorderableTaskCard → TaskCard call-sites. Reproduction verified before fix (crash) and after fix (clean render + tasks visible).
